hu.name: Chichesteri székesegyház
hu.text: A 11. században alapított templom híres a különálló harangtornyáról és a benne látható modern műalkotásokról.

hu.name: Fishbourne római palota
hu.text: Az Alpoktól északra fekvő legnagyobb római kori lakóépület, amely lenyűgöző mozaikpadlóiról nevezetes.

hu.name: Chichester Fesztivál Színház

hu.name: Pallant House Galéria

hu.text: A katedrális mögött megbújó nyugalmas park, amely pazar virágágyásokkal várja a pihenni vágyókat.

hu.name: The Novium Múzeum
hu.text: Egy római fürdő romjai fölé épített modern múzeum, amely Chichester gazdag történelmét mutatja be.

hu.name: Chichesteri csatorna

hu.name: Priory Park
hu.text: A római városfalon belül fekvő park, ahol egy ferences kolostor maradványai és a céhház is látható.

hu.name: north wing

ro.name: Catedrala din Chichester
ro.text: Fondată în secolul al XI-lea, catedrala este celebră pentru turla sa gotică și arta interioară modernă.

ro.name: Palatul Roman Fishbourne
ro.text: Cel mai mare palat roman la nord de Alpi, renumit pentru podelele sale cu mozaicuri excepțional conservate.

ro.name: Teatrul Festivalului Chichester
ro.text: Unul dintre cele mai importante teatre din Marea Britanie, cunoscut pentru designul său inovator.

ro.name: Galeria Pallant House

ro.name: Muzeul Novium
ro.text: Construit peste ruinele unor băi romane, acest muzeu prezintă istoria fascinantă a regiunii Chichester.

ro.name: Canalul Chichester
ro.text: O cale navigabilă pitorească, perfectă pentru plimbări, canotaj și observarea faunei locale sălbatice.

ro.name: Parcul Priory
ro.text: Situat în interiorul zidurilor romane, parcul găzduiește rămășițele unei mănăstiri și Guildhall.

ro.name: Biserica Sfântul Pancras
ro.text: O biserică elegantă din secolul al XVIII-lea, remarcată pentru arhitectura sa clasică și ambianța calmă.

ro.name: north wing
ro.text: Vestigiile arheologice ale aripii de nord a unei clădiri istorice.

en.name: Bishop's Palace Gardens
en.text: A tranquil hidden gem located behind the cathedral, offering beautiful floral displays and peaceful walks.

en.name: The Novium Museum
en.text: Built over the remains of a Roman bathhouse, this museum showcases the city's archaeological heritage.

en.name: Chichester Canal
en.text: A scenic waterway providing opportunities for walking, boating, and enjoying local wildlife and nature.

en.name: Priory Park
en.text: Located within the Roman city walls, this park contains the remains of a friary and the city's Guildhall.

en.name: north wing
en.text: Archaeological remains of the north wing of a historic structure.

descriptionAdvanced.de: Chichester liegt im Sueden Englands und dient als Verwaltungssitz von West Sussex. Die Stadt wurde von den Roemern als Noviomagus Reginorum gegruendet, was sich noch heute im schachbrettartigen Strassenlayout widerspiegelt. Das markanteste Bauwerk ist die Kathedrale von Chichester, die im 11. Jahrhundert gegruendet wurde und deren Turmspitze als einzige in England vom Meer aus sichtbar ist. Die Stadt ist von einer fast vollstaendigen roemischen Mauer umgeben, die heute als beliebter Wanderweg dient. Kulturell ist Chichester weltweit fuer sein Festival Theatre bekannt, das seit 1962 bedeutende Produktionen hervorbringt. Die Architektur im Zentrum ist stark georgianisch gepraegt, wobei das Chichester Market Cross aus dem Jahr 1501 den zentralen Treffpunkt bildet. Wirtschaftlich ist die Stadt ein wichtiges regionales Handelszentrum mit einer Mischung aus Einzelhandel, Dienstleistungen und Tourismus, unterstuetzt durch die Naehe zum South Downs Nationalpark und zum Chichester Harbour.
descriptionAdvanced.hu: Chichester West Sussex megye szekhelye es egyetlen varosi ranggal rendelkezo telepulese Del-Angliaban. A varost a romaiak alapitottak Noviomagus Reginorum neven, es az okori uthalozat a mai napig meghatarozza a belvaros szerkezetet. Legfontosabb muemleke a 11. szazadban alapitott Chichester-i szekesegyhaz, amelynek kulonlegessege a kulonallo harangtorony es a tengerrol is lathato templomtorony. A telepulest korulvevo romai falak csaknem teljes epsegben fennmaradtak, es setanyakent szolgalnak a latogatok szamara. A kulturális elet kozpontja a Chichester Fesztivalszinhaz, amely 1962-es megnyitasa ota nemzetkozi hirnevet szerzett. A varoskepet a georgian korabeli epiteszet es a kozponti helyen allo, 1501-ben epult piaci kereszt hatarozza meg. Gazdasaga a kereskedelemre, a szolgaltatasokra es az idegenforgalomra epul, kihasznalva a kozeli South Downs Nemzeti Park es a tengerparti kikoto vonzerejet.
descriptionAdvanced.ro: Chichester este centrul administrativ al comitatului West Sussex si singurul oras cu statut de city din regiune. Fondat de romani sub numele de Noviomagus Reginorum, planul sau urbanistic rectangular reflecta si astazi originile sale antice. Piesa centrala a orasului este Catedrala din Chichester, construita in secolul al XI-lea, a carei turla este singura din Anglia vizibila de pe mare. Orasul este inconjurat de ziduri de aparare romane aproape intacte, care ofera o ruta de plimbare pitoreasca prin istoria locala. Din punct de vedere cultural, Chichester este faimos pentru Festival Theatre, o institutie de prestigiu deschisa in 1962. Arhitectura centrului vechi este predominant georgiana, avand ca punct de reper Market Cross, o structura elaborata ridicata in 1501. Economia locala este sustinuta de turism, comert si servicii, beneficiind de proximitatea parcului national South Downs si a portului natural Chichester Harbour.
descriptionAdvanced.en: Chichester is the county town of West Sussex and the only city in the county. It was established by the Romans as Noviomagus Reginorum, and its street plan still follows the original Roman grid system. The most significant landmark is Chichester Cathedral, founded in the 11th century, which features a unique detached bell tower and a spire that serves as a landmark for sailors. The city is enclosed by nearly complete Roman walls, which are now used as a popular walking trail. Chichester is culturally significant for its Festival Theatre, which has been a major center for British drama since its opening in 1962. The city center is characterized by fine Georgian architecture and the historic Market Cross, built in 1501. Economically, Chichester serves as a regional hub for commerce and services, while its proximity to the South Downs National Park and Chichester Harbour makes it a major destination for tourism and leisure activities.
